notes: League games. `total_flags` / `flags` count every flag thrown on the team, declined and offsetting included; `accepted`, yards, `counts` and the fouls' `league_total` count accepted flags only.
phase: the feed marks pre-snap vs live ball; dead ball is ours -- unsportsmanlike conduct, sideline interference, disqualification and equipment violations.
by_side: a flag on a kick play (punt, kickoff, field goal, try) is special_teams; otherwise offense or defense by whether the team had the ball.
unknown: the feed's garbled foul codes ("H0", "OS57", "PG"), not guessed at. A stacked foul ("X S U Y") counts under its first foul.

drawn: the flags thrown on this team's opponents in the same League games, same rule. net_yards_per_game = drawn.yards_per_game - yards_per_game (positive: opponents were penalized more). Garbage time included; net_yards_per_game_competitive is the same without garbage-time plays (play_filters.is_garbage_time) -- it moves ranks, so both ship.
